description: 台灣自來水公司服務據點 [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣自來水股份有限公司. 台灣自來水公司供水範圍涵蓋全國各地(台北市及新北市部分地區除外)，自來水又是民眾生活的必需品，所以提供量足質優的自來水是台灣自來水公司的經營目標。 近幾年隨著用戶數持續增加，台灣自來水公司為滿足用戶多元需求，除了提供1910專線24小時不中斷的服務外，各縣市轄區內也有服務據點方便在地民眾，以提升本公司服務品質。 本資料集係提供台灣自來水公... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣自來水股份有限公司. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
